facts: P17 report completeness compares exact finished frame order/scenario/frame identity against selected plan and requires every REPORT_BONES entry; artifact gate requires nonempty expected-view files. This closes normal missing-selected-scenario concern in the preceding metric consumers, while image nonempty alone cannot prove semantic visual correctness.

P17 Observation separates NotApplicable/Unavailable/Measured in both serialization and required/optional predicates; range and peak aggregates are constructed through coordinated methods. No cached redundant primitive beside the wrapped quality fraction or actual measurement.

P17 full validation assembly derives report flags from actual frames and one validation_passed predicate feeds both exit and QualityScore.acceptance_passed, preventing an independently maintained acceptance conjunction there. categories/weighted quality intentionally cover a narrower rubric than overall acceptance and may disagree without authority defect.

P17 score weight sum16+8+4+2+1, catastrophic override31, normalization31, retained maximum31 and HTML denominator31 currently agree. These are independently restated rubric policy values; maintainability population retained, no existing drift or false acceptance asserted. Planned sample_hz comes from canonical locomotion_sample_rate; HTML64Hz literal remains separate diagnostic-display copy pending accepted sample-rate variability.

P17 sample fields retain expected plan, actual presentation, optional IK observations and serialized diagnostics distinctly. Actual action payload serialization derives label and sequence from one typed event; owner/name/target strings at report boundary do not themselves compete with native identity.

P17 authored angular and height wrappers retain one native scalar, delegate finite/nonnegative admission and re-admit arithmetic; radians/metres views derive from stored value. Role wrappers over shared quantities are not duplicate runtime authority. No repairs or test execution.
